title: Cellulose acetate composites with bamboo cellulose nanofibers: crystallinity preservation during tetrabutylammonium salt-catalyzed surface acetylation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7421-7429
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08474A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hao Wang, Kyoya Shirotani, Naoki Wada, Kenji Takahashi
Tetrabutylammonium-based salts were developed to modify cellulose while preserving its crystallinity. TBA2-maleate enabled efficient acetylation of nanofibers and improved dispersion in cellulose acetate, enhancing mechanical performance by 46%.
